smallest_decisive_next_check.purpose: A next development gate, not a missing prerequisite to reject the current completion claim.
smallest_decisive_next_check.check: After one bounded correction to the front/head construction hierarchy, show the pinned locked source and scoped July head beside immutable06 and the corrected candidate at the existing same camera, matched bird height and neutral lighting. Review at normal full-bird display scale plus one head crop, then one rear135/180 view for visible shell continuity. Accept only if source compactness and focal construction improve without hiding feet or losing era optics. No new lighting/exposure change should be used to obscure the discrepancy.
smallest_decisive_next_check.unseen_reference_limit: Do not infer source rear construction; the rear view only checks visually distracting candidate incompleteness.
